title: Generic Operator Workflow Improvement
summary: Improve an operator-facing workflow through governed evidence, reusable packs, and bounded local artifacts.
objective: Make an existing operational workflow easier to inspect, recover, and improve.
scope: Identify friction points and safety boundaries.
Create reusable knowledge or skill pack candidates when evidence becomes durable.
expected_outcomes: A prototype instruction outline for the improved workflow.
A research gap map for missing evidence.
A candidate comparison of improvement paths.
success_criteria: The shell surfaces current state and next operator action clearly.
Generated evidence is reusable by the Librarian.
No secrets or private runtime state are persisted in public artifacts.
